tenderSchedule.title: BGP/TENDER/VBG-RAM-G/2026-27
tenderSchedule.description: Regarding the invitation of tenders via e-procurement for the supply of materials for works to be implemented under the VBG-RAM-G scheme in the Bindiganavile Grama Panchayat of Nagamangala Taluk for the year 2026-27
tenderSchedule.deptName: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department
tenderSchedule.locationName: RDPR Gram Panchayat Office Bindiganvele TP Nagamangala

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Materials shall be supplied only when an indent is placed by the Panchayat Development Officer

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Materials shall be supplied to the site where the work is being carried out
The successful bidder must provide a Fixed Deposit (FD) equivalent to 5%.
The period of the said tender shall be in effect from October 2026 to March 2027
If the tenderer fails to supply the materials during the tender period, causing difficulties, the EMD and FD amounts will be forfeited.

The final bidder must enter into an agreement with the Panchayat Development Officer of Bindiganavile Grama Panchayat, Nagamangala Taluk, on a rs 500 stamp paper, confirming their acceptance of the tender conditions
The PDO and the Administrative Officer of the Bindiganavile Gram Panchayat hold full authority to accept or reject a tender, or to cancel a tender

The tender document can be downloaded via the e-procurement website. Any amendments, extensions of time, or further instructions regarding the tender notification must be obtained through the same website.

Tenderers must submit their bids using the two envelope system comprising a Technical Bid and a Financial Bid via the e portal. Tenderers are required to review and fully understand all documents, tender conditions, and eligibility criteria. They must then submit their complete tender including all necessary information and documentation through the e-portal, specifically using Form-1 Technical Bid on or before the prescribed date and time. Tenders containing incomplete information will be rejected.
The tender authority will open and evaluate only the financial bids of technically qualified bidders, and the eligible tenderer will be selected in accordance with the rules
Supplying materials when a supply order is placed, in accordance with the rates specified in the contract agreement.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: It is mandatory for suppliers to upload official documents of goods/materials supplied to government agencies in the previous 2 years.
The organization must submit annual transaction records for at least 2 of the last 3 years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Submit copies of complete income tax returns regarding income tax payment for the last 02 years
Submission of GST registration form of the organization

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tendering organization/individuals should not be blacklisted by any department and should not have any partnership relationship with any blacklisted organization/individuals. A certificate to this effect of Rs. 100/- on a stamped paper, certified by a notary, should be submitted.
The tenderer shall submit complete information in the prescribed Form-1 with signature regarding their financial and technical service qualification
